population: For every original claimed config, SHOW DATABASES enumerates native database sources. Independently of scanner pairs, disable all other native databases and probe each source. Classify every native response, including absence, missing targets and inert authentication. Compare the complete native set to the scanner only afterwards; fail the family on any difference.
rules: Read original configs whole; never delete source definitions or move corpus members.
Native SHOW DATABASES/PEERS/USERS/CONFIG attests membership; source positions stay C.
Native reference probe disables the referenced database, then sends an unknown-user startup to the source database; native error must name that authentication database as disabled.
Negative control replaces only that auth_dbname value with a nondeclared name in a scratch copy; native log must report that name unconfigured. Refuse wildcard or nonunique controls.
All backend host/port values use a nonexistent local socket endpoint; no backend SQL, PostgreSQL server or Docker. Native admin commands and startup packets only.
Fail the entire native reference family on any missing pair, failed config, identity mismatch, or disagreement. No C fallback in A output.
Never select probe sources or disabled targets from scanner references. Native SHOW DATABASES supplies both sets.

For each native source enable only it, disable all other native databases, and send unknown-user startup. A disabled authentication database response supplies the native target. A missing-target diagnostic is recorded and fails local-set agreement unless explicitly classified. No-user and bounded backend timeout responses indicate no observed external auth binding; disclose all classifications.
Wildcard database templates, self bindings, global settings or native responses that cannot be classified without an additional protocol fail closed; no C fallback.
Native enumeration attests completeness only for the pinned whole-input local auth_dbname family under the disclosed isolated startup conditions. Source ranges remain C.
